## 1. Open Studio on the Projects pillar

The Projects pillar lists every project forge manages.

![Open Studio on the Projects pillar](/media/stories/S3/01-open-studio-on-the-projects-pillar.png)

## 2. Open the project

The project page is where the contract lives: what forge tests with, what it demos with, what it releases with, and which skills its agents may reach for.

![Open the project](/media/stories/S3/02-open-the-project.png)

## 3. Count the skills this project binds

Nine skills — an API explorer, a resource scaffolder, a docs generator, an acceptance-test author.

![Count the skills this project binds](/media/stories/S3/03-count-the-skills-this-project-binds.png)

## 4. Read the first of them

It does not resolve.

![Read the first of them](/media/stories/S3/04-read-the-first-of-them.png)

## 5. Press "Rebuild contract", and read the drift report it produces before applying it

One press, and the report is already real — this ground needs no template named at all.

![Press "Rebuild contract", and read the drift report it produces before applying it](/media/stories/S3/05-press-rebuild-contract-and-read-the-drif.png)

## 6. Apply the rebuild

Rebuilding is not repairing.

![Apply the rebuild](/media/stories/S3/06-apply-the-rebuild.png)

## 7. Check the nine skills resolve now

The rebuild moved the skills to where the current contract expects them and rewrote the wiring that points at them.

![Check the nine skills resolve now](/media/stories/S3/07-check-the-nine-skills-resolve-now.png)

## 8. Check the secrets the rebuild had no right to touch

This is the first of the three things a rebuild must never regenerate.

![Check the secrets the rebuild had no right to touch](/media/stories/S3/08-check-the-secrets-the-rebuild-had-no-rig.png)

## 9. Check the instructions still point at the project’s own file

The second.

![Check the instructions still point at the project’s own file](/media/stories/S3/09-check-the-instructions-still-point-at-th.png)

## 10. Check the north star survived

The third.

![Check the north star survived](/media/stories/S3/10-check-the-north-star-survived.png)

## 11. Confirm preflight is MET and the project is still ready for a Flow

This is the check that says the reset was worth doing rather than merely survivable.

![Confirm preflight is MET and the project is still ready for a Flow](/media/stories/S3/11-confirm-preflight-is-met-and-the-project.png)

## 12. Run the onboarding agent to re-derive the parts a template cannot write, briefed with the contract’s own north star and gate

A template can regenerate the mechanisms forge owns.

![Run the onboarding agent to re-derive the parts a template cannot write, briefed with the contract’s own north star and gate](/media/stories/S3/12-run-the-onboarding-agent-to-re-derive-th.png)

## 13. Follow "View onboarding session" and watch it work

The session opens on the shared session surface, showing the same five-element contract buildout the project page shows — so the operator watches the Agent finish the job in the vocabulary the gate will judge.

![Follow "View onboarding session" and watch it work](/media/stories/S3/13-follow-view-onboarding-session-and-watch.png)
